title: Multiparametric continuous-time optimal control via Pontryagin's Maximum Principle: explicit solutions and comparisons with discrete-time formulations
summary: Model predictive control offers a powerful framework for managing constrained systems, but its repeated online optimization can become computationally prohibitive. Multiparametric programming addresses this challenge by precomputing optimal solutions offline, enabling real-time control through simple function evaluation. While extensively developed for discrete-time systems, this approach suffers from combinatorial growth in solution complexity as discretization is refined.
